learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn about the possible structure of economic enterprises depending on legal requirements, as well as their actions in a market economy environment as a key driver.

Students should be able to name and apply essential concepts and methods in the classic business administration functional areas of personnel, materials management/logistics, production, marketing/sales, financial management, and accounting, regarding their structure, processes, and technical terms.
Students will be taught the tension between business aspects of entrepreneurial action and potential future fields of activity of the addressed study programs, using practical examples.
The course aims to raise awareness of the lasting relevance of the topic for engineering study programs.
Students should be able to name and understand different key figures and key figure systems (Du-Pont, Balanced Score Card, etc.) for sustained success control and management.

syllabus_topics: Collective bargaining parties, co-determination, dismissal protection
Specifics for investment goods and consumer goods
Static and dynamic methods of investment appraisal
Types of financing (debt financing, equity financing, internal financing)
Annual financial statements / Profit and loss statement
Cost and performance accounting (full costing, marginal costing, process costing)
Key figure models for describing corporate success
